ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel field across >95% of the visible surface area, contrasted with sparse, high-intensity (white) punctate pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black contiguous field across both lobes; secondary spatial mapping consists of discrete, sub-10 pixel white circular blobs randomly distributed, with a slightly higher cluster density on the medial-to-distal regions of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; approximate interior angle of 40 degrees with a shallow vertical bounding-box depth relative to the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; peak pixel-amplitudes are most pronounced at intervals approximately 1/4 and 1/2 the distance from the median notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve fitted to the outer trailing edges, tapering into an upward-curving distal terminus on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple high-contrast white pixel clusters, roughly circular, localized along the superior margin of the right lobe and scattered across the mid-lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single high-contrast, unaligned linear pixel disruption (approx. 50 pixels in length) on the upper-medial region of the left lobe, oriented at a roughly 45-degree angle; secondary faint vertical linear marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct diagonal linear scar on the left lobe; cluster of white, high-intensity three-dimensional pixel protrusions (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme right distal tip.
